items.title_zh: iPhone 16 AI 功能宣传涉嫌画大饼，苹果在韩国遭正式调查
items.title_en: iPhone 16 AI feature ads accused of overpromising, Apple faces formal investigation in South Korea
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 26 日消息，苹果在韩国正面临一项正式调查，调查指控其 iPhone 16 的广告宣传就 Apple Intelligence 功能的可用性误导了消费者。 韩国公平交易委员会（FTC）的调查人员已将苹果及苹果韩国公司移交审查，称 Apple Intelligence 有多项功能未能按宣传兑现，包括 Genmoji、图像游乐场（Image Playground），以及 Siri 理解个人上下文和识别屏幕内容的能力。 这些指控的核心在于，苹果是否充分说明了哪些功能可用、其余功能何时推出。举例来说，FTC 的报告指出，Siri 的个人上下文能力曾被宣传为将于 2025 年 4 月初在韩国提供，但直到 2026 年 10 月才真正上线，晚了大约 18 个月。 据韩联社（Yonhap News Agency）报道，苹果对调查人员的结论提出异议，称公司已就功能可用时间作出提前告知。委员会尚未作出最终裁定，也未处以罚款。 此案是在美国和苹果其他主要市场出现类似针对 Apple Intelligence 广告的投诉之后发生的。2025 年 4 月，在美国全国广告审查委员会（National Advertising Division）介入调查后，苹果从其 Apple Intelligence 页面撤下了“现已可用”的营销表述。该广告监督机构认为，这一措辞暗示页面所列功能全部可用，而解释分阶段上线的脚注说明不够清楚。苹果不同意该结论，但最终遵从了建议。 苹果还在 2026 年 5 月同意以 2.5 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 16.7 亿元人民币） 和解一起美国集体诉讼，该诉讼指控苹果在 2024 年 9 月 iPhone 16 发布时，就 Apple Intelligence 和 Siri 功能的可用性误导了购买者。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 26: Apple is facing a formal investigation in South Korea, which alleges that its iPhone 16 advertising misled consumers about the availability of Apple Intelligence features. Investigators at the Korea Fair Trade Commission (FTC) have referred Apple and Apple Korea for review, saying that several Apple Intelligence features were not delivered as advertised, including Genmoji, Image Playground, and Siri's ability to understand personal context and recognize screen content. At the core of the allegations is whether Apple sufficiently explained which features were available and when the rest would launch. For example, the FTC report noted that Siri's personal context capability had been promoted as available in South Korea in early April 2025, but only actually launched in October 2026, about 18 months late. According to Yonhap News Agency, Apple disputes the investigators' conclusions, saying it gave advance notice of feature availability timing. The commission has not made a final ruling or imposed fines. The case follows similar complaints about Apple Intelligence advertising in the US and other major Apple markets. In April 2025, after the US National Advertising Division opened an inquiry, Apple removed the “available now” marketing language from its Apple Intelligence page. The advertising watchdog believed the wording implied that all features listed on the page were available, and that the footnote explaining the phased rollout was not clear enough. Apple disagreed with the conclusion but ultimately complied with the recommendation. Apple also agreed in May 2026 to settle a US class action for $250 million (IT Home note: about RMB 1.67 billion at current exchange rates), which alleged that Apple misled buyers about the availability of Apple Intelligence and Siri features when the iPhone 16 launched in September 2024.
items.why_zh: 推测：若监管认定宣传与实际可用性不符，可能加大苹果在多个市场就 Apple Intelligence 营销承担的合规与信任风险。
items.why_en: Speculation: If regulators find that advertising did not match actual availability, Apple could face greater compliance and trust risks over Apple Intelligence marketing in multiple markets.

items.title_zh: 国家数据局：建立人工智能企业输出的风险防控机制，支持和鼓励为数据付费
items.title_en: National Data Administration: Establish risk prevention mechanisms for AI companies' outputs, support and encourage paying for data
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 26 日消息，国家数据局综合司研究形成了《关于完善数据 规则 赋能 人工智能创新发展的若干意见》（公开征求意见稿），今日起向社会公开征求意见。 IT之家附主要内容如下： 一、支持合法获取的数据用于人工智能训练和推理 （一） 推动数据产权制度在人工智能用数领域运用 。各类主体通过采集生成、衍生创造等方式，以及受让取得、授权许可等合同约定的渠道获得数据，取得相应数据持有权、使用权、经营权的，在不违反法律法规和合同约定、不侵犯他人合法权益的前提下，数据使用权人可将数据用于人工智能训练和推理，数据经营权人可将数据提供给他人用于人工智能训练和推理。 （二） 支持采集生成的数据用于人工智能训练和推理 。企业对在生产经营活动中合法采集的数据，可在不违反法律法规和合同约定、不侵犯他人合法权益的前提下，用于人工智能训练和推理。企业对使用智能设备或云服务过程中产生并授权相关服务商采集的数据，有权获取或复制转移，并可将获取或复制转移后的数据自行或提供给他人用于人工智能训练和推理。服务商在获得企业明确授权、不违反法律法规的前提下，可将有关数据自行或提供给他人用于人工智能训练和推理。 （三） 推动衍生数据有序用于人工智能训练和推理 。研究细化衍生数据认定规则指引。企业对其享有使用权的数据，在不违反法律法规和合同约定、不侵犯他人合法权益的前提下，通过利用专业知识加工、建模分析、关键信息提取等方式实现数据内容、形式、结构等实质改变，从而显著提升数据价值，形成的衍生数据，可以自行或提供给他人用于人工智能训练和推理。 （四） 推动协议取得的数据依法合规用于人工智能训练和推理 。鼓励企业开展数据产权登记，明确数据产权归属。支持人工智能企业采购经数据产权登记、确认数据产权归属的数据，用于人工智能训练和推理。鼓励企业在明晰各方权属基础上，应用数据流通交易合同示范文本，签订数据流通交易合同，明确约定数据产权流转、数据用途等方面的具体安排。合同未就数据用途作出约定的，企业可在不违反法律法规、不侵犯他人合法权益的前提下将数据自行或提供给他人用于人工智能训练和推理。 二、依法平等保护相关主体合法权益 （五） 协调好数据处理者与受托方的关系 。接受他人委托处理数据的受托人，对委托处理的原始数据、过程数据、结果数据等，除法律另有规定或合同另有约定外，不享有持有权、使用权、经营权。受托人可在符合法律法规要求、获得委托人明确授权且不侵犯他人合法权益的前提下，自行或提供他人用于人工智能训练和推理。 （六） 支持和鼓励为数据付费 。支持人工智能企业组建数据部门，加大数据投入，通过合法采集、协议购买、以数换数、模型换数据等方式，为高质量数据付费。大力推动行业高质量数据集建设和市场流通交易，提升面向人工智能的语料数据供给力度。支持人工智能企业通过提供免费、高质量人工智能创作工具等方式，加强面向创作者的利益反哺，探索建立中长期利益协同机制。法律对特定类型数据另有规定的，从其规定。 （七） 建立人工智能企业输出的风险防控机制 。人工智能企业作为技术提供方，应主动采取合理必要措施，不得生成危害国家安全、社会公共利益等法律、行政法规禁止的内容，不得侵害他人隐私、商业秘密、著作权等合法权益，不得有悖于主流价值导向，建立应急处置机制、用户投诉反馈渠道并及时处置。已落实法律、行政法规的规定，采取合理必要措施的，可作为减轻或免除相应法律责任的事实依据。未采取合理必要措施，损害公共利益或他人合法权益的，依法承担相应责任。 三、完善数据流通责任认定和安全治理机制 （八） 建立数据质量评价机制 。推动建立分行业分场景的数据质量测评认证机制，完善面向人工智能应用的数据质量测评标准，支持有条件的机构开展数据质量测评。加强数据标准贯标，增强公共数据供给标准化、规范化能力。 （九） 完善数据流通责任认定机制 。推动建立基于数据产权登记凭证的数据流通责任机制，探索将数据产权登记凭证作为认定数据流通中买受方是否履行合理注意义务、是否存在主观过错，以及减轻或免除买受方相应民事或行政责任的重要考量因素。企业基于获得的数据已开发形成模型的，若事后发现数据存在合规问题，在依法承担相应责任、不违反法律规定情况下，仍可对模型成果享有相关权益。 （十） 完善数据流通纠纷调解机制 。建立完善专业化的数据纠纷调解、仲裁等争议解决…
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 26: The Comprehensive Department of China's National Data Administration has formulated the “Several Opinions on Improving Data Rules to Empower AI Innovation and Development” (draft for public comment) and began soliciting public comments today. The document supports the use of lawfully obtained data for AI training and inference, covering channels such as collection and generation, derivative creation, acquisition by transfer, and licensing, and promotes the application of the data property rights system in AI data use. It clarifies that entrusted data processors do not enjoy holding, use, or operation rights over original, process, or result data unless otherwise provided by law or contract. It supports and encourages paying for data, promotes the construction of high-quality industry datasets and market circulation and trading, and seeks to increase corpus data supply for AI. It requires establishing risk prevention mechanisms for AI companies' outputs: companies must not generate content prohibited by laws and administrative regulations that harms national security or public interests, must not infringe privacy, trade secrets, copyright, or other lawful rights, and must establish emergency response mechanisms and user complaint feedback channels. It also proposes improving data quality evaluation, liability determination for data circulation, and dispute mediation mechanisms, and exploring the use of data property registration certificates as an important consideration in determining whether buyers in data circulation fulfilled reasonable care obligations, had subjective fault, or should have liability reduced or exempted.
items.why_zh: 推测：该征求意见稿若落地，将影响中国 AI 训练数据供给、数据交易责任认定与生成内容合规边界。
items.why_en: Speculation: If finalized, the draft would affect AI training data supply, liability determination in data transactions, and compliance boundaries for generated content in China.

items.summary_zh: 由 42 个州总检察长组成的联盟正试图阻止 Character.AI 在推进 Chapter 11 破产程序期间出售用户数据。在一系列几乎相同的新闻稿中，这些总检察长指责该公司计划拍卖“超过 2100 万个美国账户的私人聊天历史，其中超过 210 万个账户注册者为未成年人”，且未对聊天记录被出售的人提供保障。报道称，Character.AI 于 10 月申请破产，此前数年该公司丑闻和法律挑战不断，包括来自迪士尼的挑战。迪士尼最终收购了该公司部分资产并聘请其 CEO K…… 完整报道见 The Verge。
items.summary_en: A coalition of 42 state attorneys general is trying to prevent Character.AI from selling off user data as it navigates Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings. In October, Character.AI filed for bankruptcy following years of scandals and legal challenges , including from Disney . Disney ended up buying some of the company's assets and hiring its CEO , K … Read the full story at The Verge.
items.why_zh: 推测：若出售获准，大量含未成年人数据的私密对话将进入商业交易，凸显破产场景下用户隐私保护的缺口。
items.why_en: Speculation: If the sale is allowed, large volumes of private conversations, including data involving minors, would enter commercial transactions, highlighting gaps in user privacy protection in bankruptcy scenarios.

items.title_zh: 横跨 L2、L3、L4：华为靳玉志重申乾崑智驾 HUAWEI ADS 5 为自动驾驶而来
items.title_en: Across L2, L3 and L4: Huawei's Jin Yuzhi reiterates Qiankun ADS 5 is built for autonomous driving
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 26 日现场消息，在今晚的 2026 华为乾崑生态大会上，华为智能汽车解决方案 BU CEO 靳玉志登台发表主题演讲。他重申， 华为乾崑智驾 HUAWEI ADS 5 为自动驾驶而来 。 据IT之家此前报道，去年 11 月，在华为乾崑生态大会上，靳玉志宣布：华为乾崑智驾 ADS 高速 L3 解决方案的商用之路即将启程， 并公开了华为乾崑智驾 ADS 的 L3 专属人机交互页面 。 今年 4 月 23 日晚，华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5 正式发布 。算法层面，华为发布了面向自动驾驶的 AI 智能体 WEWA 2.0 架构。该架构在云端引入 Multi-Agent 博弈技术与在线强化学习机制；在车端应用了安全风险场技术进行实时安全评估，并通过 Driving Agent 模块完成出行任务的策略优化。 华为官方曾表示，华为乾崑智驾 ADS 4 Max / Pro / SE 升级到华为乾崑智驾 ADS 5 Max / Pro / SE 对应版本，不存在硬件限制。
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on Nov 26 from the scene that at tonight's 2026 Huawei Qiankun Ecosystem Conference, Jin Yuzhi, CEO of Huawei Intelligent Automotive Solution BU, delivered a keynote. He reiterated that Huawei Qiankun ADS 5 is built for autonomous driving. According to previous IT Home reports, in November last year at the Huawei Qiankun Ecosystem Conference, Jin announced that the commercial path for Huawei Qiankun ADS high-speed L3 solution was about to begin, and unveiled the L3-dedicated human-machine interaction page for Huawei Qiankun ADS. On the evening of April 23 this year, Huawei Qiankun ADS 5 was officially released. At the algorithm level, Huawei released the WEWA 2.0 architecture, an AI agent for autonomous driving. The architecture introduces Multi-Agent game technology and online reinforcement learning mechanisms in the cloud; on the vehicle side it applies safety risk field technology for real-time safety assessment, and uses the Driving Agent module to optimize strategies for travel tasks. Huawei officially said there is no hardware limitation for upgrading Huawei Qiankun ADS 4 Max / Pro / SE to the corresponding ADS 5 Max / Pro / SE versions.
items.why_zh: 推测：重申 ADS 5 面向自动驾驶，显示华为正为从高速 L3 向更高级别自动驾驶推进做产品与合规叙事准备。
items.why_en: Speculation: Reiterating that ADS 5 is built for autonomous driving may signal that Huawei is preparing its product and compliance narrative for advancing from high-speed L3 to higher-level autonomous driving.

items.title_zh: GPT-6.2 额度突然不耐用了？OpenAI 承认计费出错，修复后 Astra 消耗速度加快 40%、Sol 加快 25%
items.title_en: GPT-6.2 Quotas Suddenly Run Out Faster? OpenAI Admits Billing Error; After Fix, Astra Consumption Speeds Up 40% and Sol 25%
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息，OpenAI 已紧急修复 GPT-6.2 上线初期的一项计费错误 —— 此前该问题导致大多数用户使用 GPT-6.2 Astra 和 Sol 时，消耗的套餐额度按折扣价进行了计算。 OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux（Tibo）表示，修复后，用户完成相同工作量时将消耗更多额度：与上周相比，Astra 用户触及使用上限的速度将加快 40%，Sol 用户则将加快 25%。 Sottiaux 同时表示，尽管修复后两款模型的额度消耗速度有所增加，但与上一代 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 相比，GPT-6.2 Astra 和 Sol 的额度使用效率仍然更高。此次计费错误没有影响其他模型， OpenAI 也不会追溯收取此前少计的额度差额 。 作为补偿，OpenAI 将向 Go、Plus、Pro 和 Business 套餐用户各提供一次额外的额度重置机会。该重置额度可以留存，用户无需在获得后立即使用。 此外，Sottiaux 还公布了面向 Business 用户的额外安排：在 2026 年 12 月 31 日之前，Business 套餐用户可以免费使用 Fast Mode（快速模式），无需额外付费。 Sottiaux 此前还确认，OpenAI 已开始向一小部分 Pro 用户测试 Chat（聊天）与 Work（工作）模式的合并体验，以收集用户反馈，并为后续扩大推送范围做准备。 合并后的体验旨在减少用户在普通对话与智能体工作模式之间手动切换的需求。Work 模式能够处理更复杂的多步骤任务，包括执行操作、处理文件等，但相较于普通聊天，其任务执行过程通常更加复杂，资源消耗也可能更高。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov. 27: OpenAI has urgently fixed a billing error from the early launch period of GPT-6.2—previously, the issue caused most users using GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to have their plan quota consumption calculated at a discounted price. Thibault Sottiaux (Tibo), head of OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT, said that after the fix, users will consume more quota for the same amount of work: compared with last week, Astra users will reach their usage limit 40% faster, and Sol users 25% faster. Sottiaux also said that although the two models' quota consumption speed has increased after the fix, GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol are still more quota-efficient than the previous generation GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol. The billing error did not affect other models, and OpenAI will not retroactively charge for the previously undercounted quota difference. As compensation, OpenAI will give Go, Plus, Pro and Business plan users one additional quota reset each. The reset quota can be saved, and users do not need to use it immediately after receiving it. In addition, Sottiaux announced an extra arrangement for Business users: before Dec. 31, 2026, Business plan users can use Fast Mode for free without extra charge. Sottiaux previously also confirmed that OpenAI has begun testing a merged Chat and Work mode experience with a small group of Pro users to collect feedback and prepare for a later broader rollout. The merged experience aims to reduce the need for users to manually switch between ordinary conversation and agentic work mode. Work mode can handle more complex multi-step tasks, including performing actions and handling files, but compared with ordinary chat, its task execution process is usually more complex and may consume more resources.
items.why_zh: 推测：计费修复和补偿安排会影响用户对 GPT-6.2 额度成本的实际感受，也显示新模型上线初期的计费与配额机制仍可能调整。
items.why_en: Speculation: the billing fix and compensation may affect users' practical perception of GPT-6.2 quota costs, and suggest that billing and quota mechanisms can still be adjusted early after a new model launch.

items.title_zh: 腾讯用 AI 挑战药物研发领域前沿难题：成果登 Nature，在减重降糖、肿瘤免疫方向完成验证
items.title_en: Tencent uses AI to tackle a frontier drug-discovery problem: results published in Nature, validated in weight-loss/glucose-lowering and tumor-immunity directions
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 26 日消息，腾讯今日宣布，11 月 25 日，腾讯生命科学实验室的一项 AI for Science 研究成果，正式以第一单位登上《Nature》主刊。 据介绍， 腾讯用 AI 挑战了药物研发领域的一个前沿难题：高活性双靶点治疗性多肽的从头设计 。通俗来说，就是不依赖已有的分子模板，从零开始设计一把能打开两把锁的“钥匙”，为复杂疾病的治疗提供新的可能。 围绕这个问题，团队经过长期探索，研发了 AI 平台 ORIDTP，将扩散生成模型、双目标强化学习、柔性多肽亲和力建模与生物学实验相结合，跑通了一套“计算设计 — 实验验证 — 反馈优化”的研发闭环。 ▲ ORIDTP 是一个用于设计高活性双靶点肽的 AI 平台 这让传统依赖大规模分子库盲筛的研发模式，转向 AI 驱动的小样本精准迭代。每轮实验仅需测试约 15 条多肽。 团队已在两个机制迥异的药理方向完成验证 ： 减重降糖 ：在肥胖及糖尿病小鼠模型中，以低于对照药物的摩尔剂量，观察到显著的减重与控糖效果。 肿瘤免疫 ：在特定人源靶点敲入小鼠肿瘤模型中，候选分子使肿瘤体积较对照组减少 94.2%。 目前，研究仍处于临床前阶段，尚未开展人体临床试验。 ▲ 双靶点多肽在基因敲入小鼠中的抗肿瘤活性 目前，ORIDTP 已部署至一站式生命科学 AI 工作台「腾讯健康 BioNexus」，面向科研社区开放，也可以在 WorkBuddy 找到它。 IT之家附论文链接： https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-11338-1
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 26: Tencent announced today that on Nov 25, an AI for Science study by Tencent Life Science Laboratory was officially published as the first affiliation in the flagship journal Nature. According to the announcement, Tencent used AI to tackle a frontier problem in drug discovery: the de novo design of high-activity dual-target therapeutic peptides. In plain terms, without relying on existing molecular templates, the team designed from scratch a “key” that can open two locks, offering new possibilities for treating complex diseases. Around this problem, after long exploration, the team developed the AI platform ORIDTP, combining diffusion generative models, dual-objective reinforcement learning, flexible peptide affinity modeling, and biological experiments, and established a R&D loop of “computational design — experimental validation — feedback optimization.” This shifts the traditional R&D model relying on large-scale blind screening of molecular libraries toward AI-driven, small-sample precise iteration. Each round of experiments only needs to test about 15 peptides. The team has completed validation in two pharmacologically distinct directions: weight loss and glucose control — in obese and diabetic mouse models, significant weight loss and glucose control effects were observed at lower molar doses than the comparator drug; tumor immunity — in a specific human target knock-in mouse tumor model, candidate molecules reduced tumor volume by 94.2% compared with the control group. The research is still at the preclinical stage and has not yet conducted human clinical trials. ORIDTP has been deployed to the one-stop life sciences AI workbench “Tencent Health BioNexus,” is open to the research community, and can also be found in WorkBuddy. Paper link: https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-026-11338-1
items.why_zh: 推测：若临床前结果可复现并推进临床，AI 从头设计双靶点多肽可能缩短药物发现周期并拓展复杂疾病治疗路径。
items.why_en: Speculation: If the preclinical results are reproducible and advance to clinical trials, AI-based de novo design of dual-target peptides could shorten drug discovery cycles and expand treatment paths for complex diseases.

items.title_zh: 消息称育碧正大力推动将生成式 AI 深度融入游戏开发流程，项目若未引入 AI 需申报原因
items.title_en: Report: Ubisoft is pushing hard to deeply integrate generative AI into game development; projects without AI must justify why
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 26 日消息，据外媒 Vertical Slice 报道，育碧正在大力推动生成式 AI 深度融入游戏开发流程，如今公司团队在提交新游戏项目提案时，必须说明生成式 AI 能够如何帮助开发游戏，如果团队不打算使用生成式 AI，则需要向公司高层明确解释原因。 多名员工透露， 如果某个游戏项目提案没有涉及生成式 AI，同时给予高管的理由不能够让人信服，就很难获得批准 。 还有匿名员工表示：“公司告诉我们，使用 AI 能够提高小型、精简且灵活的团队提交项目提案的速度。管理层希望团队能够快速推进、反复迭代，并及时放弃不合适的项目，从而筛选出真正有潜力的创意。” 过去一年多以来，育碧一直在进行大规模业务重组，包括成立新的子公司、将旗下《刺客信条》《孤岛惊魂》《彩虹六号》等主要游戏品牌整合至不同的创意部门，同时关闭部分工作室，并经历了多轮裁员。 一名员工对此表示，育碧目前陷入了由管理层自上而下推动的“AI 狂热噩梦”，公司内部士气本就不高，而首席执行官 Yves Guillemot 已经将公司的未来押注在这项技术上，并要求其他员工跟随这一方向。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 26: According to foreign media outlet Vertical Slice, Ubisoft is strongly pushing generative AI deep into its game development process. Teams submitting new game project proposals must now explain how generative AI can help develop the game; if a team does not plan to use generative AI, it must clearly explain why to senior management. Multiple employees said that if a game project proposal does not involve generative AI and the reason given to executives is not convincing, it is difficult to get approved. An anonymous employee said: “The company told us that using AI can increase the speed at which small, lean and flexible teams submit project proposals. Management wants teams to move quickly, iterate repeatedly, and promptly abandon unsuitable projects, so as to screen out ideas with real potential.” Over the past year or more, Ubisoft has been undergoing large-scale business restructuring, including establishing new subsidiaries, integrating major game brands such as Assassin's Creed, Far Cry and Rainbow Six into different creative departments, closing some studios, and going through multiple rounds of layoffs. One employee said Ubisoft is now trapped in a top-down “AI hype nightmare” pushed by management; internal morale was already low, and CEO Yves Guillemot has bet the company's future on this technology and asked other employees to follow this direction.
items.why_zh: 推测：若报道属实，提案审批与资源分配向生成式 AI 倾斜，可能加剧育碧内部士气和创意流程争议，并影响其重组成效。
items.why_en: Speculation: If the report is accurate, tilting proposal approval and resource allocation toward generative AI could intensify internal morale and creative-process disputes at Ubisoft and affect the results of its restructuring.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 再度抛出重要数学成果：宣称证明矩阵乘法指数为 9/4
items.title_en: OpenAI Claims Another Major Math Result: Proving the Matrix Multiplication Exponent Is 9/4
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 26 日消息，OpenAI 本月 24 日再度抛出一项重要数学成果， 宣称其已证明矩阵乘法指数 ω 恰好为 9/4 。该企业已在今年 10 月证得 ω≤9/4，此次则证得 ω≥9/4，从而得到 ω=9/4。 矩阵乘法指数 ω 描述的是：当 n 足够大时，两个 n×n 矩阵相乘最优算法所需算术运算次数随 n 增长的渐进幂指数；更严格地说，ω 是所有可达复杂度指数的下确界。 矩阵乘法 应用广泛 ，在机器学习、图像处理等领域都可以找到其身影。ω 不仅刻画矩阵乘法理论算法在渐进意义下的最优指数，也 与其它一系列重要复杂度问题相关 。 若 OpenAI 的证明无误，则： 对任意 X＞9/4，存在一种矩阵乘法算法及常数 C X ＞0，使得对所有充分大的 n ，其算术运算次数不超过 C x · n x ； 对任意 Y＜9/4，不存在一种矩阵乘法算法及常数 C Y ＞0，使得对所有充分大的 n，其算术运算次数不超过 C Y · n Y 。 需要注意的是，ω 是一个渐进量，对应着矩阵规模趋于无穷大时的结果。实际应用中还受到常数因子、内存访问、并行计算、硬件结构等因素影响。 参考 https://github.com/openai/math/blob/main/preprints/The-matrix-multiplication-exponent-is-nine-fourths-November-24-2026
items.summary_en: IT之家 November 26 news: On the 24th of this month, OpenAI once again put forward a major mathematical result, claiming that it has proved that the matrix multiplication exponent ω is exactly 9/4. The company proved ω≤9/4 in October this year, and this time it proved ω≥9/4, thereby obtaining ω=9/4. The matrix multiplication exponent ω describes: when n is sufficiently large, the asymptotic power exponent by which the number of arithmetic operations required by the optimal algorithm for multiplying two n×n matrices grows with n; more strictly, ω is the infimum of all achievable complexity exponents. Matrix multiplication is widely used, and can be found in fields such as machine learning and image processing. ω not only characterizes the optimal exponent of theoretical matrix multiplication algorithms in the asymptotic sense, but is also related to a series of other important complexity problems. If OpenAI's proof is correct, then: for any X>9/4, there exists a matrix multiplication algorithm and a constant C_X>0 such that for all sufficiently large n, its number of arithmetic operations does not exceed C_X · n^X; for any Y<9/4, there does not exist a matrix multiplication algorithm and a constant C_Y>0 such that for all sufficiently large n, its number of arithmetic operations does not exceed C_Y · n^Y. Note that ω is an asymptotic quantity, corresponding to the result when matrix size tends to infinity. In practical applications, it is also affected by factors such as constant factors, memory access, parallel computing, and hardware architecture. Reference https://github.com/openai/math/blob/main/preprints/The-matrix-multiplication-exponent-is-nine-fourths-November-24-2026
items.why_zh: 推测：若该证明经核实无误，将是矩阵乘法复杂度理论的重要进展，但目前仍属 OpenAI 的单方面宣称。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the proof is verified, it would be a major advance in matrix multiplication complexity theory, but it remains OpenAI's unilateral claim for now.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 26 日消息，据路透社报道，瑞士联邦网络安全局（BACS）周四通报，过去几天瑞士发生五起网络攻击，攻击者使用 AI 智能体针对企业以及关键基础设施运营方发起入侵。 IT之家注意到，该局在公告中表示，五起攻击里有四起攻击得手，相关系统遭到入侵。遭到攻击的对象包含三家关键基础设施运营主体，据瑞士公共广播公司 SRF 介绍，它们分别是电力、供水以及通信服务供应商。 瑞士联邦网络安全局没有透露攻击的幕后主体信息。机构建议相关企业落实防护手段，其中包括定期开展网络安全检测。
items.summary_en: IT之家 November 26 news: According to Reuters, the Swiss Federal Cyber Security Agency (BACS) reported on Thursday that in the past few days five cyberattacks occurred in Switzerland, in which attackers used AI agents to launch intrusions against enterprises and critical infrastructure operators. IT之家 noted that the agency said in its announcement that four of the five attacks succeeded and the relevant systems were breached. The targets included three critical infrastructure operators; according to Swiss public broadcaster SRF, they are electricity, water, and communications service providers. The Swiss Federal Cyber Security Agency did not disclose information about the actors behind the attacks. The agency recommended that relevant enterprises implement protective measures, including regular cybersecurity testing.

items.why_en: Speculation: if the reported announcement is accurate, it would highlight the real-world risk of AI agents being used to attack critical infrastructure.

items.summary_en: In Panton, Vermont, population 660, town clerk Kyle Rowe did it all. items.title_zh: 彭博社：欧洲市值最高的软件公司 SAP 计划裁员超 1 万人，约占总员工 9%
items.title_en: Bloomberg: SAP, Europe’s Most Valuable Software Company, Plans to Cut More Than 10,000 Jobs, About 9% of Workforce
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 27 日消息， 彭博社昨日（11 月 26 日）发布博文，报道称德国软件巨头思爱普（SAP）正考虑在一轮以人工智能为核心的重组中，裁减至少 1 万个工作岗位。 该规模约相当于 SAP 全球员工总数的 9%，最终裁员人数尚未确定，后续或因公司与劳工代表的协商结果而有所调整。 IT之家查询公开资料，思爱普成立于 1972 年，总部位于德国沃尔多夫，是全球企业应用软件的重要供应商，是“欧洲市值最高的软件公司”。其核心产品帮助企业完成财务、供应链、采购、人力资源、销售和运营等流程的数字化管理。 知情人士称，SAP 管理层正推动软件业务向 AI 时代转型，要求各部门梳理可以精简的岗位和业务环节。产品与工程部门、销售部门被视为此次重组的重点领域。公司计划将 AI 工具更深入地整合到其企业应用软件中，同时调整产品开发和销售模式，以适应客户需求和市场竞争的变化。 此次拟议裁员若最终落实，将是该公司不到三年内的第二轮大规模重组。SAP 曾于 2024 年启动一项涉及约 1 万个职位的重组计划，主要通过自愿离职和员工再培训等方式推进；由于同期仍在招聘，公司整体员工规模并未出现明显下降。 值得注意的是，SAP 近期业绩并不疲弱。该公司第三季度营收同比增长 13%，达到 102.7 亿欧元，经营利润增长 18%，达到 29.3 亿欧元。管理层推动重组，更多被外界解读为在 AI 竞争加剧背景下，重新配置资源、提高组织效率。 SAP 首席执行官克里斯蒂安 · 克莱因正推动“AI 优先”的发展战略，希望借助生成式 AI 和智能体，把传统企业软件升级为更自动化的工作平台。 针对裁员传闻，SAP 回应称，公司会持续检视组织架构，以配合发展战略和客户需求，但拒绝就是否计划裁员作出具体评论。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov. 27: Bloomberg yesterday (Nov. 26) published a post reporting that German software giant SAP is considering cutting at least 10,000 jobs in an AI-centered restructuring. That scale is about 9% of SAP's total global workforce; the final number of layoffs has not been determined and may be adjusted later depending on the outcome of consultations between the company and labor representatives. According to public information checked by IT之家, SAP was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Walldorf, Germany. It is an important global supplier of enterprise application software and is “Europe’s most valuable software company.” Its core products help companies digitize the management of processes such as finance, supply chain, procurement, human resources, sales and operations. People familiar with the matter said SAP management is pushing the software business to transform for the AI era and requiring departments to identify positions and business areas that can be streamlined. The product and engineering department and the sales department are seen as key areas of this restructuring. The company plans to integrate AI tools more deeply into its enterprise application software and at the same time adjust product development and sales models to adapt to changes in customer needs and market competition. If the proposed layoffs are ultimately implemented, it will be the company's second large-scale restructuring in less than three years. SAP launched a restructuring plan involving about 10,000 positions in 2024, mainly advanced through voluntary departures and employee retraining; because it was still hiring during the same period, the company's overall headcount did not decline noticeably. Notably, SAP's recent performance is not weak. Its third-quarter revenue grew 13% year on year to €10.27 billion, and operating profit grew 18% to €2.93 billion. Management's push for restructuring is more often interpreted by outsiders as reallocating resources and improving organizational efficiency amid intensifying AI competition. SAP CEO Christian Klein is promoting an “AI-first” development strategy, hoping to use generative AI and agents to upgrade traditional enterprise software into a more automated work platform. In response to the layoff rumors, SAP said it will continue to review its organizational structure to align with its development strategy and customer needs, but declined to comment specifically on whether it plans to lay off employees.

items.why_en: Speculation: if the layoff plan is implemented, it would show SAP reallocating resources and streamlining its organization under an AI-first strategy, and could become a case for observing how the enterprise software industry adjusts roles and business models around generative AI.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 26 日消息，据路透社报道，荷兰多家消费者与数字权益组织于周四向法院提出申请，要求叫停 Meta 旗下 AI 智能眼镜在荷兰的销售。原告方主张，这款眼镜允许佩戴者在他人不知情的情况下进行拍摄，违反了欧洲隐私法规。 这起民事诉讼仅针对荷兰市场，但阿姆斯特丹地区法院的简易判决有可能形成判例。目前，这类智能眼镜已经在全球范围内引发公众强烈反对，不少场所出台禁令，监管机构也陆续发出警示。 原告包括荷兰最大的消费者协会消费者联盟（Consumentenbond）、以及致力于打击网络性侵害的组织 Offlimits。他们表示，这款由 Meta 和雷朋母公司依视路陆逊梯卡（EssilorLuxottica）合作开发的眼镜触犯隐私法律，会让民众身处公共场合时始终心存顾虑，对社会产生寒蝉效应。 原告提出诉求：要求 Meta 阻止用户利用这款眼镜在他人不知情的状态下录像，不得使用录制的影像训练 AI 模型；在合规整改完成前暂停销售。如果拒不执行，原告申请对每名被告处以每日 10 万欧元的罚款，罚款上限为 1 亿欧元。 Offlimits 的代理律师卡琳 · 汉（Karlijn Han）在庭审中表示，这款眼镜被人用来偷拍私密影像。她在开庭陈述中提到：“有人利用它在考场、更衣室、泳池、酒店客房、医院，还有游乐场和海滩偷偷录像。每一次隐私侵害，都比上一次更加恶劣。” Meta 否认使用影像训练 AI Meta 的代理律师巴斯蒂安 · 肯普（Bastiaan Kemp）请求法院驳回起诉。他称，原告要求的管控措施会损害正常使用者的权益，打击 Meta 的市场竞争力，相当于强制产品召回，而且无法解决其他同类设备带来的同类隐患。 “产品厂商不应该为每一起故意滥用设备的行为承担责任。”他在法庭上说。他表示镜架上配备了录制指示灯，旁人能够直观看到设备正在录像。 同时他否认了消费者联盟律师提出的指控，即 Meta 在欧洲处理眼镜拍摄的画面、或是违规将画面用于训练 AI 模型。 Meta 与其合作厂商依视路陆逊梯卡在 2025 年一共售出 700 多万副智能眼镜，占据全球约八成市场份额。 依视路陆逊梯卡的律师则辩称，该公司既不会处理拍摄的视频素材，也没有访问这些素材的权限；而且市面上还有其他品牌同类产品，销售禁令属于处罚过度，很难起到实际效果。 全球多地接连出台限制措施 IT之家注意到，反对浪潮已经蔓延至世界各地。澳大利亚、挪威酝酿相关管控规则，英格兰、威尔士以及纽约州的法院已经出台禁令，各国政府和司法机构都在防范偷拍行为、保护敏感信息。英国影院也出于隐私和防盗版的考虑，对这类眼镜作出限制。 本周二，德国全国消费者联合会宣布，就隐私侵权问题起诉 Meta 与雷朋，称普通人很难在公共场合使用这款眼镜时遵守欧洲数据保护法规。 欧洲数据保护委员会在 10 月就发出提醒，智能眼镜存在重大隐私风险，需要设置更严格的防护机制。 荷兰隐私监管局 AP 本月建议消费者不要购买这类智能眼镜 ，认为它对佩戴者和路人的隐私都存在威胁。早在 10 月，荷兰连锁眼镜店 Hans Anders 就已经在荷兰和比利时停售 Meta 的雷朋智能眼镜。 在美国，Meta 也面临集体诉讼，被控不当分享眼镜采集到的私人影像。 荷兰这起案件的宣判日期尚未确定，预计会在 12 月中旬给出裁决。
items.summary_en: Reuters reported that several Dutch consumer and digital-rights groups filed a court application on Thursday to halt sales of Meta’s AI smart glasses in the Netherlands. The plaintiffs include the Netherlands’ largest consumer association, Consumentenbond, and Offlimits, an organization focused on combating online sexual abuse. They argue the glasses let wearers record people without their knowledge, violating European privacy law and creating a chilling effect. The civil suit targets only the Dutch market, but a summary judgment by the Amsterdam District Court could set a precedent. The plaintiffs ask Meta to prevent users from recording without others’ knowledge, not to use recorded footage to train AI models, and to suspend sales until compliance fixes are made; if not, they seek €100,000 per defendant per day, capped at €100 million. Offlimits lawyer Karlijn Han said the glasses have been used to secretly film in exam rooms, changing rooms, pools, hotel rooms, hospitals, playgrounds and beaches. Meta lawyer Bastiaan Kemp asked the court to dismiss the case, saying the measures would harm normal users and Meta’s competitiveness, amount to a forced recall, and fail to address similar risks from other devices; he said the frames have a recording indicator light and denied that Meta processes footage in Europe or improperly uses it to train AI. Meta and EssilorLuxottica sold more than 7 million smart glasses in 2025, about 80% of the global market, according to the report; EssilorLuxottica’s lawyer said the company does not process or have access to video footage and that a sales ban would be excessive. The report also noted that Australia and Norway are considering rules; courts in England, Wales and New York state have issued bans; UK cinemas have restrictions; Germany’s national consumer federation sued Meta and Ray-Ban on Tuesday over privacy infringement; the European Data Protection Board warned in October of major privacy risks; the Dutch privacy regulator AP advised consumers this month not to buy such glasses; Dutch chain Hans Anders stopped selling Meta’s Ray-Ban smart glasses in the Netherlands and Belgium in October; and Meta faces a US class action over allegedly improperly sharing private images captured by the glasses. A ruling in the Dutch case is expected in mid-December.

items.title_zh: 消息称马斯克为采购存储芯片曾主动提出为三星工厂提供融资担保，被李在镕拒绝
items.title_en: Report: Musk offered to guarantee financing for Samsung plant in memory-chip push; Lee Jae-yong declined
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 26 日消息，据华尔街日报于当地时间 11 月 25 日报道，资本集团（Capital Group）投资组合经理卡尔 · 卡瓦贾（Carl Kawaja）回忆了他与马斯克就特斯拉存储芯片问题进行的一次交谈。 卡瓦贾称，马斯克表示他曾向三星提出长期芯片（IT之家注：根据原报道上下文，此处指存储芯片）采购承诺，结果三星会长李在镕却回答说，其他所有人都在向他提供同样的条件，你还能拿出什么别的筹码？ 而当马斯克随后提出为三星的新芯片工厂提供融资担保时， 李在镕的回答依然是：其他所有人都在向他提供同样的条件，你还能拿出什么别的筹码？ 资本集团和三星拒绝置评。特斯拉未回应置评请求。 报道还提到，芯片买家正长期驻守在韩国，希望讨好三星和 SK 海力士。科技行业高管表示， 一些人工智能巨头甚至将员工直接派驻在三星芯片制造工厂周边的住宅里 ，以便每天上门盯梢并确保交付按计划推进。 豪华汽车制造商 Karma Automotive 的首席执行官马奎斯 · 麦卡蒙（Marques McCammon）在过去六个月里四次飞往韩国，与一家主要存储芯片供应商会面，以至于他现在在首尔都有了一家最喜欢的烤肉店。 麦卡蒙表示，虽然存储芯片供应商愿意洽谈，但一到敲定价格和交货日期时就变得含糊其辞：“出于礼貌，他们会抽出时间见面，但要做出决定非常困难。”
items.summary_en: The Wall Street Journal reported on Nov. 25 local time that Capital Group portfolio manager Carl Kawaja recalled a conversation with Elon Musk about Tesla’s memory-chip needs. Kawaja said Musk offered Samsung a long-term memory-chip purchase commitment, but Samsung Chairman Lee Jae-yong replied that everyone else was offering the same terms and asked what else Musk could offer. When Musk then offered to guarantee financing for Samsung’s new chip plant, Lee gave the same reply, according to the report. Capital Group and Samsung declined to comment, and Tesla did not respond to a request for comment. The report also said chip buyers are stationed in South Korea for long periods to court Samsung and SK Hynix; some AI giants have even placed employees in residences near Samsung chip plants so they can visit daily and ensure deliveries stay on schedule. Karma Automotive CEO Marques McCammon flew to South Korea four times in the past six months to meet a major memory-chip supplier. He said suppliers are willing to talk but become vague when it comes to settling prices and delivery dates: “Out of courtesy, they make time to meet, but it is very difficult to make decisions.”
items.why_zh: 推测：这反映 AI 热潮下存储芯片供应紧张，买方的供应保障与议价竞争加剧。
items.why_en: Speculation: this reflects tight memory-chip supply amid the AI boom, intensifying buyers’ competition for supply security and bargaining leverage.

items.title_en: Huawei Qiankun App 2.0 released: one-tap smart insurance claims, Cloud View 3.0 with two-way real-time intercom
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 26 日现场消息，在今晚的 2026 华为乾崑生态大会上，华为智能汽车解决方案 BU CEO 靳玉志发布了华为乾崑 App 2.0 版本。 据介绍，华为乾崑 App 2.0 版本提供云瞰、智能报险、AI 助手、云畅听、达人 Club、乾智驾公开赛、乾智驾学堂、用户共创等功能。 其中，云瞰升级至 3.0 版本， 带来了远程回看、行车录像、远程查看、双向对讲等功能 ；新增智能报险功能， 支持一键直连保司，3 分钟快速报险 。 据IT之家了解，华为乾崑 App 是专为乾崑用户打造的交流互动平台，有社区、探索、ADS、展厅、爱车、商城六大核心板块；支持心愿单共创、答复车机语音助手反馈的问题、ADS 安全分析及 60+ 远控功能与数字钥匙，满足基本用车需求。
items.summary_en: According to an on-site report by IT之家 on November 26, at that evening's 2026 Huawei Qiankun Ecosystem Conference, Jin Yuzhi, CEO of Huawei's Intelligent Automotive Solution BU, released Huawei Qiankun App version 2.0. The version is said to offer features including Cloud View, smart insurance claims, an AI assistant, Cloud Audio, Talent Club, the Qiankun Smart Driving Open Challenge, the Qiankun Smart Driving Academy, and user co-creation. Cloud View has been upgraded to version 3.0, adding remote playback, driving recorder footage, remote viewing and two-way intercom; a new smart insurance claims feature allows one-tap direct connection to insurers with claims filed in three minutes. According to IT之家, the Huawei Qiankun App is an interaction platform built for Qiankun users, with six core sections: Community, Explore, ADS, Showroom, My Car and Mall; it supports wish-list co-creation, answering questions fed back through the in-car voice assistant, ADS safety analysis, and 60+ remote control functions plus a digital key, covering basic vehicle-use needs.

items.title_zh: 靳玉志：华为乾崑总搭载 26 个品牌 62 款车型
items.title_en: Jin Yuzhi: Huawei Qiankun deployed on 26 brands and 62 models
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 26 日现场消息，华为公司高级副总裁、引望公司 CEO 靳玉志在华为乾崑生态大会上披露，截至 11 月 25 日，华为乾崑总搭载车型品牌数量 26 个，总搭载车型数量 62 款，华为智能汽车解决方案部件发货量超过 1 亿件。 此外，乾崑智驾、鸿蒙座舱搭载量双双突破 200 万台，乾崑 App 用户超 280 万。今年前三季度乾崑 ADS 新车销量超 50 万台，城区领航辅助国内市场第一。 靳玉志明确乾崑智驾 ADS 5 为自动驾驶而来，可支撑 L3、L4 高阶自动驾驶落地，目前其云端算力达 60EFLOPS，累计辅助驾驶里程已突破 183 亿公里。 IT之家注意到，靳玉志此次还发布了辅助驾驶新品牌 ——“星驰”，预计明年有超过 10 款搭载星驰辅助驾驶的新车上市。据悉，星驰专注于辅助驾驶，寓意“星耀千家，驰骋万里”。
items.summary_en: IT Home, November 26, on-site: Jin Yuzhi, senior vice president of Huawei and CEO of Yinwang, disclosed at the Huawei Qiankun Ecosystem Conference that as of November 25, Huawei Qiankun had been deployed on 26 vehicle brands and 62 models in total, and shipments of Huawei intelligent automotive solution components had exceeded 100 million units. In addition, installations of Qiankun ADS and HarmonyOS cockpit both exceeded 2 million units, and the Qiankun App had more than 2.8 million users. In the first three quarters of this year, sales of new vehicles with Qiankun ADS exceeded 500,000 units, ranking first in the domestic urban navigation assistance market. Jin Yuzhi made clear that Qiankun ADS 5 is built for autonomous driving and can support the deployment of L3 and L4 high-level autonomous driving; its cloud computing power currently reaches 60 EFLOPS, and cumulative assisted-driving mileage has exceeded 18.3 billion kilometers. IT Home noted that Jin Yuzhi also launched a new assisted-driving brand, Xingchi, and expects more than 10 new cars equipped with Xingchi assisted driving to go on sale next year. Xingchi focuses on assisted driving and means “stars illuminate thousands of homes, galloping ten thousand miles.”
items.why_zh: 推测：若这些搭载与里程数据准确，显示华为智能汽车方案规模化落地，并以“星驰”区分辅助驾驶与未来自动驾驶产品线。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 26 日现场消息，华为公司高级副总裁、引望公司 CEO 靳玉志在华为乾崑生态大会上披露，截至 11 月 25 日，华为乾崑总搭载车型品牌数量 26 个，总搭载车型数量 62 款，华为智能汽车解决方案部件发货量超过 1 亿件。 此外，乾崑智驾、鸿蒙座舱搭载量双双突破 200 万台，乾崑 App 用户超 280 万。今年前三季度乾崑 ADS 新车销量超 50 万台，城区领航辅助国内市场第一。 靳玉志明确乾崑智驾 ADS 5 为自动驾驶而来，可支撑 L3、L4 高阶自动驾驶落地，目前其云端算力达 60EFLOPS，累计辅助驾驶里程已突破 183 亿公里。 IT之家注意到，靳玉志此次还发布了辅助驾驶新品牌 ——“星驰”，预计明年有超过 10 款搭载星驰辅助驾驶的新车上市。据悉，星驰专注于辅助驾驶，寓意“星耀千家，驰骋万里”。

items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov. 27: Valve officially announced that, to welcome the Black Friday shopping season, Steam has revamped and upgraded its “Discounts & Events” page. Although Steam itself is not holding an official Black Friday sale, developers and publishers are voluntarily offering discounts on various games from now until Nov. 30, and Steam has also decorated the page with a Black Friday theme. The update concerns not only the page's appearance but also how content is displayed. After opening the page, users can see personalized game recommendations based on personal interests, combined with currently popular games and rising content, showing related games and categories. Steam confirmed that the Black Friday theme decoration will be removed on Nov. 30 (Pacific Time), but the page experience improvements will not end then and will remain. Users who need it can still visit the page after Black Friday to browse the latest game discounts and event information on Steam. IT之家 selected some popular games, such as 007 First Light at ¥135 (original price ¥298; 45% of original price), Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora at ¥64 (original price ¥128; 50% of original price), and Baldur's Gate 3 at ¥188 (original price ¥268; 70% of original price).

items.title_en: Huawei: Qiankun ADS and Xingchi assisted driving will differ in specific functions and experience
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 26 日消息，在今晚的 2026 华为乾崑生态大会上， 华为智能汽车解决方案 BU CEO 靳玉志正式发布了华为星驰辅助驾驶系统 。 IT之家从华为官方了解到， 星驰辅助驾驶与乾崑智驾技术同源、资源共享 ：将采用技术同源的 WEWA（世界引擎 + 世界行为模型）架构，共享乾崑智驾的云端算力和数据资源，此外还将遵从同一套研发流程与车规级质量管理体系。 华为表示， 星驰辅助驾驶与乾崑智驾二者在具体功能和体验方面会有所差异 ，但安全算法、稳定性和可靠性不变。根据华为官方定义：乾崑智驾 ADS 历经 5 代演进，未来将主要面向自动驾驶；星驰专注于辅助驾驶，寓意“星耀千家，驰骋万里”。
items.summary_en: IT Home, November 26: At tonight's 2026 Huawei Qiankun Ecosystem Conference, Jin Yuzhi, CEO of Huawei Intelligent Automotive Solution BU, officially launched the Huawei Xingchi assisted-driving system. IT Home learned from Huawei's official information that Xingchi assisted driving and Qiankun ADS share the same technical origin and resources: they will adopt the same-origin WEWA (World Engine + World Behavior Model) architecture, share Qiankun ADS's cloud computing power and data resources, and also follow the same R&D process and automotive-grade quality management system. Huawei said Xingchi assisted driving and Qiankun ADS will differ in specific functions and experience, but safety algorithms, stability, and reliability remain unchanged. According to Huawei's official definition: Qiankun ADS has evolved through five generations and will mainly target autonomous driving in the future; Xingchi focuses on assisted driving, meaning “stars illuminate thousands of homes, galloping ten thousand miles.”
items.why_zh: 推测：此举可能将高阶自动驾驶与辅助驾驶品牌分层，覆盖不同市场定位；细节仍以华为发布为准。
items.why_en: Speculation: this may layer the brands for high-level autonomous driving and assisted driving to cover different market positions; details remain subject to Huawei's announcement.

items.title_zh: 让渐冻症患者“开口说话”，我国首例无线侵入式汉语脑机接口临床试验成功开展
items.title_en: First wireless invasive Chinese-language brain-computer interface clinical trial in China helps ALS patient “speak”
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 26 日消息，复旦大学今日发文，介绍了脑机接口的里程碑新突破：成功开展了 我国首例无线侵入式汉语脑机接口临床试验 ，让渐冻症患者实现了“靠意念就能交流”。 身患渐冻症的李阿姨无法顺畅发声，仅仅轻轻动一动嘴唇，屏幕立刻浮现文字，设备随后传出带着她本人音色的语音。 我重新点燃了生活的希望，真心期盼这项研究早日成熟，帮到更多有需要的病友。 这一幕，来自复旦大学附属华山医院 / 现代语言学研究院路俊锋、毛颖、张梦翰团队，联合中国科学院脑科学与智能技术卓越创新中心赵郑拓、阶梯医疗李雪及上海科技大学李远宁等团队在“脑科学与类脑研究”国家科技重大专项的支持下自主研发取得的阶段性成果 —— 汉语双靶点脑机接口系统 。 2026 年 9 月，团队开展我国首例无线侵入式汉语脑机接口临床试验。 患者接受 512 通道的微创电极植入手术，佩戴信息采集装置， 通过默念想要表达的语言内容，系统就能采集语言发音运动相关脑区的神经信号， 结合深度学习算法完成解码，再将结果转化为屏幕上的文字和语音，真正实现了 “靠意念就能交流” 。 “首例临床试验初步验证了技术的安全性与有效性，未来有望惠及全国数以百万的语言功能障碍患者。” 复旦大学附属华山医院院长毛颖教授表示，这项研究不仅为构音障碍患者提供了新的交流可能，也为建立面向汉语的脑机接口技术与知识体系探索了新路径。 李阿姨正是这项汉语脑机接口临床试验的首位参与者。今年 9 月，她完成植入手术。经过一个多月训练，在开放式自由表达测试中（理论上覆盖所有汉字）： 发声状态下，实时汉字解码准确率 95% 以上，解码速度约 80 字 / 分钟；默念状态下，实时汉字解码准确率达到 90% 以上，解码速度约 110 字 / 分钟。 系统输出的文字，还经过音色克隆还原李阿姨本人的声音。 对比现有辅助沟通方案，不管是头皮脑电、眼动追踪等方式，本质都依赖逐字选择的打字式交互，患者实际交流速度通常低于 40 字 / 分钟，使用过程费时费力。而侵入式脑机接口技术可直接解码大脑言语运动皮层的神经信号，未来有望接近乃至达到正常人的自然交流速度。 IT之家获悉，为了给患者提供更多选择， 团队还在同步开发移动端应用 。行动能力尚可的患者，可以直接在手机上使用，实现自然交互。 下一步，团队将 持续提升解码准确率，优化设备便携性与操作流程，扩大临床验证范围，并探索将技术拓展至脑卒中后失语等更多语言障碍人群。 预计未来 2-3 年，这项技术有望惠及更多患者。
items.summary_en: IT Home, November 26: Fudan University announced today a milestone breakthrough in brain-computer interfaces: China's first clinical trial of a wireless invasive Chinese-language brain-computer interface was successfully conducted, enabling an ALS patient to “communicate by thought.” Aunt Li, who has ALS, cannot speak smoothly; with only a slight movement of her lips, text immediately appeared on the screen, and the device then produced speech in her own voice. “I have rekindled hope in life and sincerely hope this research matures soon to help more patients in need.” This scene comes from a phased result independently developed by the team of Lu Junfeng, Mao Ying, and Zhang Menghan at Huashan Hospital affiliated to Fudan University / Institute of Modern Languages and Linguistics, together with teams including Zhao Zhengtuo of the CAS Center for Excellence in Brain Science and Intelligence Technology, Li Xue of StairMed, and Li Yuanning of ShanghaiTech University, under the support of the National Science and Technology Major Project for “Brain Science and Brain-Like Research”—a Chinese dual-target brain-computer interface system. In September 2026, the team conducted China's first clinical trial of a wireless invasive Chinese-language brain-computer interface. The patient underwent minimally invasive implantation of 512-channel electrodes and wore an information collection device; by silently thinking of the language content she wanted to express, the system could collect neural signals from brain regions related to speech articulation and movement, complete decoding with deep learning algorithms, and then convert the results into text and speech on the screen, truly achieving “communication by thought.” “The first clinical trial preliminarily verified the safety and effectiveness of the technology, and in the future it is expected to benefit millions of patients with language dysfunction across the country,” said Professor Mao Ying, president of Huashan Hospital affiliated to Fudan University. This research not only provides a new communication possibility for patients with articulation disorders, but also explores a new path for building a Chinese-language brain-computer interface technology and knowledge system. Aunt Li was the first participant in this Chinese-language brain-computer interface clinical trial. This September, she completed implantation surgery. After more than a month of training, in an open-ended free expression test (theoretically covering all Chinese characters): in the voiced state, real-time Chinese character decoding accuracy exceeded 95%, with a decoding speed of about 80 characters per minute; in the silent state, real-time Chinese character decoding accuracy reached over 90%, with a decoding speed of about 110 characters per minute. The text output by the system also used voice cloning to restore Aunt Li's own voice. Compared with existing assistive communication solutions, whether scalp EEG or eye tracking, they essentially rely on character-by-character typing interaction, and patients' actual communication speed is usually below 40 characters per minute, making the process time-consuming and laborious. Invasive brain-computer interface technology can directly decode neural signals from the brain's speech motor cortex and is expected in the future to approach or even reach the natural communication speed of healthy people. IT Home learned that to provide patients with more options, the team is also developing a mobile app. Patients with some mobility can use it directly on a mobile phone for natural interaction. Next, the team will continue to improve decoding accuracy, optimize device portability and operating procedures, expand the scope of clinical validation, and explore extending the technology to more people with language disorders such as post-stroke aphasia. It is expected that in the next 2-3 years, this technology may benefit more patients.
items.why_zh: 推测：若首例试验数据可重复，汉语侵入式脑机接口或为构音障碍患者提供更高速交流路径；目前仅为阶段性成果。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the first-trial data can be reproduced, an invasive Chinese-language brain-computer interface could offer a faster communication path for patients with articulation disorders; currently this is only a phased result.

items.title_zh: 深蓝汽车成华为星驰首批合作伙伴，双 07 率先搭载全新辅助驾驶系统
items.title_en: Deepal becomes first Huawei Xingchi partner; dual 07 models to be first with new assisted-driving system
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 26 日现场消息，在今晚的 2026 华为乾崑生态大会上， 华为智能汽车解决方案 BU CEO 靳玉志正式发布了华为星驰辅助驾驶系统 。 深蓝汽车董事长邓承浩现场透露，全新深蓝 S07 AI 激光版和即将上市的全新深蓝 L07 AI 激光版 是行业首批搭载华为星驰驾驶辅助解决方案的车型 。 据介绍，这两台车是当前市面上唯一能体验星驰魅力的车型， 当前已经硬件预埋 ，所有新老用户，明年都将通过 OTA 免费升级为正式的华为星驰智能驾驶辅助。 IT之家了解到，在明日的广州车展，全新深蓝 L07 AI 激光版将正式上市，全面承接华为星驰的最新成果，瞄准 15 万级智能辅助驾驶市场。 ▲ 全新深蓝 S07 AI 激光版
items.summary_en: IT Home, November 26, on-site: At tonight's 2026 Huawei Qiankun Ecosystem Conference, Jin Yuzhi, CEO of Huawei Intelligent Automotive Solution BU, officially launched the Huawei Xingchi assisted-driving system. Deepal Chairman Deng Chenghao revealed on site that the new Deepal S07 AI Laser Edition and the upcoming new Deepal L07 AI Laser Edition are among the industry's first models equipped with the Huawei Xingchi driver-assistance solution. According to the introduction, these two cars are currently the only models on the market where Xingchi can be experienced; hardware is already pre-installed, and all new and existing users will receive a free OTA upgrade to the official Huawei Xingchi intelligent driving assistance next year. IT Home understands that at tomorrow's Guangzhou Auto Show, the new Deepal L07 AI Laser Edition will officially launch, fully carrying Huawei Xingchi's latest results and targeting the 150,000-yuan-class smart assisted-driving market. ▲ New Deepal S07 AI Laser Edition
items.why_zh: 推测：这表明华为星驰先通过深蓝车型落地，并以OTA覆盖存量用户；实际功能待验证。
items.why_en: Speculation: this indicates Huawei Xingchi is first landing through Deepal models and using OTA to cover existing users; actual functions remain to be verified.

items.title_zh: 未来汽车可以自己去换电池！华为乾崑智驾与宁德时代巧克力换电打通，智能补能解决方案发布
items.title_en: Future cars could swap batteries themselves: Huawei Qiankun ADS connects with CATL Chocolate battery swap, smart energy-replenishment solution released
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 26 日现场消息，在今晚的 2026 华为乾崑生态大会上，华为智能汽车解决方案 BU CEO 靳玉志正式官宣华为乾崑智驾 × 宁德时代巧克力换电达成合作， 并发布了智能补能解决方案 。 IT之家从大会现场了解到，智能补能解决方案支持智能补能体系，可提供电池安全服务。 智能补能体系 补能预约，一键直达 园区内 / 跨园区代客补能 智能补能规划 电池安全服务 共建电池安全标准 双重 BMS 检验 + 四层安全防护 实时健康监测与故障诊断 宁德时代市场联席总裁杨峻提到，等以后到了自动驾驶时代，汽车还可以实现自己去换电补能，车主不用担心汽车没电的情况发生。
items.summary_en: IT Home, November 26, on-site: At tonight's 2026 Huawei Qiankun Ecosystem Conference, Jin Yuzhi, CEO of Huawei Intelligent Automotive Solution BU, officially announced that Huawei Qiankun ADS and CATL's Chocolate battery swap have reached cooperation, and released a smart energy-replenishment solution. IT Home learned from the conference site that the smart energy-replenishment solution supports a smart replenishment system and can provide battery safety services. Smart replenishment system: replenishment reservation with one-click direct access; valet replenishment within and across parks; smart replenishment planning. Battery safety services: co-build battery safety standards; dual BMS inspection + four-layer safety protection; real-time health monitoring and fault diagnosis. Yang Jun, CATL market co-president, mentioned that in the future autonomous-driving era, cars can also swap batteries and replenish energy by themselves, so car owners need not worry about running out of battery.
items.why_zh: 推测：若落地，将把自动驾驶与换电补能网络结合，减少用户补能操作；目前为合作与方案发布阶段。
items.why_en: Speculation: if implemented, it would combine autonomous driving with battery-swap energy networks to reduce user charging operations; this is currently at the cooperation and solution announcement stage.

items.title_en: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space
items.summary_zh: 据 The Verge 报道，FCC 在周三的公告中表示，已授权 SpaceX 部署最多 100 万颗搭载 AI 芯片的卫星，作为这家马斯克旗下公司“Starmind”计划的一部分。谷歌和蓝色起源等多家公司也在探索把 AI 数据中心送入太空的想法，这是该机构首次批准完整的 AI 卫星“星座”。批准条件要求 SpaceX 在 2033 年前部署至少一颗卫星，并在 2040 年前达到 100 万颗的里程碑。FCC 还推迟了 SpaceX 的一项请求，该请求涉及将 600 公里以上的卫星处置于太空“墓地”轨道的问题（原文在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: In an announcement on Wednesday , the FCC says it authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million AI chip-equipped satellites as part of the Elon Musk-owned company's "Starmind" initiative . With several others also pursuing the idea of putting AI data centers in space , including Google and Blue Origin, this is the first approval the agency has granted for a full "constellation" of AI satellites. The FCC's approval requires SpaceX to deploy at least one satellite by 2033, and meet the 1 million satellite milestone by 2040. items.why_zh: 推测：若该规模获批落地，轨道 AI 算力部署与太空碎片治理规则可能同时面临新的压力。

items.title_zh: 氛围编程是否让开源成为合成器的新常态？
items.title_en: Has vibe coding made open source the new normal for synths?
items.summary_zh: 据 The Verge 报道，强大的氛围编程（vibe coding）智能体以及 Reverse Engineer Anything 等工具的出现，在音乐器材行业引发混乱，令各家公司在如何应对上手忙脚乱。罗兰（Roland）等一些公司目前保持沉默，另一些则选择拥抱改装社区。过去几周，随着人们意识到没有哪件音乐器材能躲过 Claude 和一群热衷于折腾的 Reddit 网友，越来越多公司开始把设备开源。做出“打不过就加入”决定的最大牌公司是 inMusic——Akai、Moog、Native Instruments 等品牌的母公司（原文在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: The emergence of powerful vibe-coding agents and tools like Reverse Engineer Anything has caused chaos in the music gear world , leaving companies scrambling to figure out how to respond. While some, like Roland, have remained silent for now, others have embraced the modding community. In the last several weeks, as it's become clear that no piece of music gear is safe from Claude and a subreddit full of curious tinkerers, companies have begun making more and more of their devices open source. items.why_zh: 推测：AI 工具降低了逆向工程与改装门槛，可能迫使硬件厂商重新权衡固件封闭与社区生态之间的取舍。
items.why_en: Speculation: AI tools lower the barrier to reverse engineering and modding, potentially forcing hardware makers to reweigh closed firmware against community ecosystems.
